name: Adjacent
tagline: Prediction-market indices, reference rates, and CFTC filings from Adjacent
description: One Adjacent pane, opened with ADJ. Tabs are Indices, Rates, and CFTC. An index opens onto its chart, constituents, related news, and filings. Chart any series from a chart's add series search. Public endpoints need no key. Related index filings and the authenticated catalog need an Adjacent API key. Public CFTC filings cover the last 90 days.
